title: State vs. Akram Khan (Timber Smuggling)
offense_details: Illegal harvesting of Deodar trees during night-shift trespassing in Kalam Forest.
text: The accused was found guilty of smuggling 45 units of Deodar timber during the night. The court imposed a heavy fine of 250,000 PKR and 2 years imprisonment.

title: Govt of KPK vs. ABC Logging Ltd
offense_details: Corporate trespassing into protected Scrub forest area.
text: Case involving corporate logging without permit. 120 scrub trees were removed. The company was fined 1.5 million PKR for permit violation.

title: Malik Safdar vs. Forest Dept
text: Defendant was acquitted of cutting 5 pine trees as it was proven the wood was windfall, not cut from living trees.
